CookieConsent.title: We use cookies
CookieConsent.desc: We use our own and third-party cookies to improve your experience, analyze traffic and personalize content. You can accept all, accept only the necessary ones or customize your preferences.
CookieConsent.necessaryDesc: Required for the site to function properly. Includes session, language, and security cookies. Cannot be disabled.
CookieConsent.functionalDesc: Remember your preferences (theme, language, region) to offer you a personalized experience on future visits.
CookieConsent.analyticsDesc: Help us understand how you interact with the site anonymously. Used to improve performance and user experience.
